title: $u$-Equations for Arbitrary Hyperbolic Surfaces
exact_target: Determine whether the proposed coordinate equations extend to every hyperbolic surface with boundary and marked cusps.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004940 (OWR-8415362-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Scattering Amplitudes, Cluster Algebras, and Positive Geometries (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/57, pp. 3101--3133. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The $u$-equations refer to the source construction, not an unspecified scalar differential equation. The complete coordinate presentation and admissible surface conventions must accompany an extension.
